description: Weigh-In-Motion Station Vehicle Traffic Counts: 2013 is a dataset listed in State of New York open data portal (data.ny.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of New York. This data set is a list of daily vehicle counts, in each direction, taken at the weigh-in-motion (WIM) stations operated by the New York State Department of Transportation (NYSDOT) during the 2013 calendar year. Coverage: New York State. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are traffic counts, wim. The table has 29 columns. Attribution on the portal: New York State Department of Transportation (DOT). The portal shows 2015-02-04 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ny-gov-portal.
